topics.topic: Approval state transition when owner approves but pre-send checks then fail in the same request
questions: If the owner approves but a pre-send check then fails (for example binding became stale), what exact approval status must be recorded (`approved` unused, `used`, or other), and is this path still considered "sends at once"?

If the owner approves but pre-send checks fail in that same request (for example binding stale), what is the required approval state transition: stay `approved` and unused, become `used`, or refuse the approve action itself?

topics.topic: Authority precedence outside resume when both unused approval and active standing grant exist
questions: Outside resume, if both an unused approval and an active grant exist for the same send, which one must be consumed/recorded as authority?
Outside resume-specific paths, if both authorities exist for the same element, which one must be used and recorded in `EffectAttempt.authority`?

topics.topic: Deterministic detection of token-list file content changes for reload
questions: How is "content has changed" detected deterministically (mtime, inode+size, hash, always-read), especially when the file becomes temporarily unreadable?
How must the kernel detect that the configuration content changed (and avoid missing or double-applying a change)?

topics.topic: Definition of output_bytes for `many` file outputs (elements vs container overhead)
questions: For a `many` file output, is `output_bytes` the sum of element byte lengths only, or does it also include list/container encoding overhead?

topics.topic: Error/refusal type when token-file reread is bad/unreadable (temporary-unavailable vs generic auth refusal)
questions: Must these refusals be a distinct temporary-unavailable error (different from auth refusal), or the same generic refusal format as unknown/revoked token?

topics.topic: Exact byte accounting basis for A09 response-size limit (what parts/encoding count)
questions: What bytes are counted for response size: body only or status+headers+body, and for compressed transfers is the limit on wire bytes, decoded bytes, or both?

topics.topic: How to mark sandbox_violation when trapped calls are caught by user code
questions: What concrete mechanism marks a run as sandbox_violation if trapped calls are caught inside user code?

topics.topic: Refusal-reason ordering when multiple A04 add/capture validations fail
questions: If multiple add/capture conditions fail at once, what exact refusal reason ordering is required?

topics.topic: Refusal-reason precedence when multiple A02 contract-issuance validations fail
questions: When several A02 conditions fail in one request, which refusal reason must be returned?

topics.topic: Strict acceptance criteria for JSON responses in A09 checks
questions: What exact conditions make a JSON body acceptable (required `Content-Type`, charset handling, duplicate keys, non-UTF-8 bytes)?

topics.topic: What qualifies as a fresh approval after not_applied when prior approval records already exist
questions: After `not_applied`, if a prior approval record for that element still exists (for example old `requested`/`approved`/`used` history), what exactly counts as "fresh approval" and when must a new approval record be created?

topics.topic: Whether A03 random/clock trapping uses a fixed explicit function list or dynamic runtime exports
questions: Is the trap set for `random` a fixed explicit list, or dynamically all exported module-level functions in that runtime build?

topics.topic: Whether proof failures in node-phase checks must be reported as node failures or normalized to edges only
questions: When proof fails in a node-phase check (for example missing contract version), must the failure be reported as a node failure, or must results be normalized so only edges are ever reported?
